board.astral_craft.demo_loop.desc: Minimal board graph for development testing. Production maps should use structure templates plus board JSON.
Name: A.L. Wilson
Birthday: January 2
Favorite Food: Cheese
One of the founders of "The Cellar", maintaining close ties to "Phoenix Sky Club" and the Enfield family, often known simply as "A.L." He was the holder of the weapon "Tennou" and the key figure behind the "Tennou Drop" incident. A.L. decision to destroy the "Tennou" for reasons unknown triggered the subsequent corporate war. The destruction of the weapon triggered a series of mysterious events that once again plagued Union City. It was this very incident that brought the legendary weapon back into the public consciousness.
After the "Tennou Drop" incident, A.L. disappeared without a trace and his whereabouts are unknown.
character.astral_craft.al.skill.active.p: Choose 1-3 cards to give to a character, gain Star Coins equal to the number of cards given.
Choose 1-3 cards to give to a character, then steal 3 times the number of given cards in Star Coins from the recipient.
When making other characters gain cards, both parties gain +1 stack of Starlight. For every 7 stacks of Starlight you accumulate, Attack +1, Defense +1.
When gaining Star Coins, Attack +2, Defense +1, lasting 1 round.
character.astral_craft.alana.profile.bas:
Name: Alana Gresta
Birthday: February 21
Favorite Food: Taro
Abbess of the Asterism Monastery in Union City, a government funded institute that houses orphans from all over Asterism, of which Alana is one.
She joined the Combat Sisters after Exorcism Night. She helps out with the day to day operations of the monastery, and is rarely seen outside.
character.astral_craft.alana.skill.activ: Immune to traps, avoids combat for 1 turn when using an active skill, and automatically triggers the passive skill if it hasn’t been activated.
character.astral_craft.alana.skill.passi: ATK +3 if no damage was taken in the previous round. (non-stackable, reset upon damage)
character.astral_craft.ame.profile.basic:
Name: Ame-chan
Birthday: 05/05
Favorite Food: Unknown
Looks quiet but pretty selfish
and gets carried away.
A troublesome personality
with a need of approval.
Heal HP equal to the 【Love】 stacks, then gain movements equal to the 【Love】 stacks. At the turn's end, remove 4 【Love】 stacks.
character.astral_craft.ame.skill.passive: When damage is received, the 【Love】 status is applied, stacking up to a maximum of 4. Each stack grants 1 ATK and reduces 1 DEF. This status starts with 2 stacks.
character.astral_craft.bonnie.profile.ba:
Name: Bonnie・Mollà・Glenwood
Birthday: January 1st
Favorite Food: Apple Pie
Graduating from Central City University's School of Law, in the same class as Fanny, she also possesses a PhD. Bonnie has a rather intense personality, and once set the entire dorm on fire while trying to catch a mouse. Despite all this, she has a sharp mind and is highly intelligent, earning her the nickname 'Poison Apple'.

Fanny and her are known as the dual detectives of Union City, though their two personalities clash quite fiercely.
She's currently investigating the incident surrounding Fanny's disappearance, hoping to find her.
character.astral_craft.bonnie.skill.acti:
Select a monster, applying Investigation Target to them.
They gain 1 stack of Mark, and then you gain 2 × their Mark stacks coins.
When a monster affected by Investigation Target is KO'd, trigger Secret Investigation, and advance Secret Investigation to its next stage.

Select an enemy character, applying Investigation Target to them.
They gain 2 stacks of Mark.
When a character affected by Investigation Target is KO'd, trigger Secret Investigation and gain 5 coins.
character.astral_craft.bonnie.skill.pass:
Add Secret Investigation to the map's Event pool.
When attacking a monster affected by Mark, gain +3 ATK.
When KOing a monster affected by Mark, gain 1 Battle Card.

Add Secret Investigation to the map's Event pool.
When attacking an enemy affected by Mark, gain +3 ATK.
When KOing an enemy affected by Mark, gain 1 Battle Card.
character.astral_craft.dorothy.profile.b:
Name: Dorothy Haze
Birthday: November 5
Favorite Drink: Piano Woman
Dorothy is a VA-11 Hall-A regular that quickly becomes one of Jill's closest friends. Despite being a Lilim (artificial humanoid), Dorothy is consistently one of the most perceptive people in any given room, a skill she uses to constantly get reactions out of others with colorful and sordid tales from her line of work. She loves socializing as much as she hates dogs.
character.astral_craft.dorothy.skill.act:
Instantly teleport to the position of an allied character. When passing through an ally this turn, both you and the ally gain +1 ATK (Cannot stack).
If "Warmth" has reached 5 stacks when using the skill, gain bonus ATK equal to your current DEF for 1 turn, then consume all stacks of "Warmth".

Recover 1 HP and freely choose your movement direction this turn.
If "Warmth" has reached 5 stacks when using the skill, gain bonus ATK equal to your current DEF for 1 turn, then consume all "Warmth".
character.astral_craft.dorothy.skill.pas:
When recovering HP: Gains 1 stack of "Warmth" (each stack adds +1 DEF, stacking up to 5 times).
When passing by another character: Recovers 1 HP for both you and the other character.

When recovering HP: Gains 1 stack of "Warmth" (each stack adds +1 DEF, stacking up to 5 times).
When passing by another character: Recovers 1 HP for both you and the other character and steals 1 Star Coin from the target.
character.astral_craft.fanny.profile.bas:
Name: Fanny Craig
Birthday: February 17
Favorite Food: Strawberry Cake
Having solved loads of intricate cases, Fanny is a big shot in Grayson Detective Agency, the prestigious agency to exist in Union City. Her law doctor degree isn't something you should take lightly.
Ever since the Tennou Drop incident, she has mysteriously disappeared, leaving only her old photograph as a proof of her existence.
character.astral_craft.fanny.skill.activ: Trigger an additional event at the end of the turn.
character.astral_craft.fanny.skill.passi: Gain 3 coin after triggering the event.
character.astral_craft.fen.profile.basic:
Name: JiMeng Feng
Birthday: November 7
Favorite Food: Beef balls
The owner of the best restaurant in Union City, the Longxing Restaurant. Her true identity is the boss of the Phoenix Sky Club, and people in the underworld call her "Princess". Fen has a close business relationship with Parunan, is Ren's childhood friend, and is one of the Primary Stars.
She and her sister can sometimes be seen at the Longxing Restaurant supervising the workers.
Heal 2 HP. If Energy Conservation is active, +4 ATK for 1 turn.
Heal 2 HP. If Energy Conservation is active, +3 ATK for 1 turn.
character.astral_craft.fen.skill.passive: If you do not engage in battle during your turn, +2 ATK and +2 DEF at the end of your turn (Lasts until next battle).
If you do not engage in battle during your turn, +2 ATK and +2 DEF at the end of your turn (Lasts until next battle).
Name: HaiQing
Birthday: March 22
Favorite Food: Strawberry
She's the owner of the fortune-telling shop "Sun and Moon". Although she looks mature, she only graduated from college a few years ago. She's very popular with customers because of her personality and appearance. It's rumored that the club she joined in college was an intelligence organization collecting information about the "Star Engine". On weekends, she goes to a bar called "Rainbow Prism" and has been friends with the bartender there, Kurara, for many years.
Her appearance has changed significantly since her college days.
character.astral_craft.hai_qing.skill.ac: Mark a monster, increase his damage taken +1 for 2 turns. If the monster is knocked out while the effect is active, HaiQing gets +3 coins.
Mark a player and his damage taken +1 for 2 turns. During the turns, if the player's HP declines to 0, HaiQing gets 4 coins. If not, the player recovers 4 HP.
character.astral_craft.hai_qing.skill.pa: Get 6 coins if the movement point is 6
Get 6 coins if the movement point is 6
character.astral_craft.ink_shadow.profil:
Name: InkShadow
Birthday: Unknown
Favorite Food: Fried High-Calorie snacks
Nancy Lu's 'roommate', who once went on offline missions with Nancy's deceased partner. A creature that operates in 'cat form', calling itself Ink Shadow due to its entirely black appearance. Its personality is somewhat similar to a middle aged man, yet it speaks in a rather childlike manner. Whether from staying in the 'cat form' for too long, or other reasons entirely, its behaviour and way of thinking have become increasingly catlike.
It witnessed firsthand the accident that happened to Cha, Nancy Lu's 'close friend'.
Select a shadow to teleport to, then absorb all shadows. Each shadow absorbed increases your ATK by +1 for 1 turn.
Absorb all shadows. Each shadow absorbed increases your ATK by +1 and DEF by +1 for 1 turn.
At the start of the turn and when an attack hits, place a 【Shadow】 on the tile where InkShadow is located. It lasts for 2 turns. Enemy characters and monsters standing on the shadow take 1 damage.
At the start of the turn and when an attack hits, place a 【Shadow】 on the tile where InkShadow is located. It lasts for 2 turns. Enemy characters and monsters standing on the shadow take 1 damage.
character.astral_craft.jasmine.profile.b:
Name: Jasmine
Birthday: August 12
Favorite Food: N/A
The robot made by the hobby club during HaiQing's time at university.
The core system of the robot is a highly advanced AI acquired from the "Dark Web".
After graduation, Jasmine was taken to Ramsey Biotechnology by another club member, Luga Pixie, and has since become a valuable assistant.
Jasmine always regards Lulu as waste disposal. Although Lulu has protested many times, Jasmine remains undeterred and enjoys it.
character.astral_craft.jasmine.skill.act:
When using skill, DEF -3, Movement Points +3.
Lasts 1 turn.
character.astral_craft.jasmine.skill.pas: Every 13 movement points[1] alternately increase +1 ATK or DEF, permanent for this battle.
character.astral_craft.jill.profile.basi:
Name: Jill Stingray
Birthday: June 27
Favorite Drink: Beer
Jill is a BTC-certified bartender currently working at the VA-11 Hall-A Bar (nicknamed "Valhalla").
Single mother of a black, blue-eyed cat named Fore; Jill spends her free time browsing the internet and fighting the urge to make unnecessary purchases that would make her miss paying rent next month. Despite this simple way of life, however, oddities keep being flung her way, including supposed sightings of some ghost girl.
character.astral_craft.jill.skill.active:
Choose 3 cards, then applies effects to one character in sequence based on the card types:
Effect Card: Recover 1 HP
Attack Card: Gain +1 ATK this turn
Defense Card: Gain +1 DEF this turn
Afterward, discard the 3 selected cards and draw the same number of new cards.

Choose 3 cards, then apply effects to yourself in sequence based on their types:
Effect Card: Recover 1 HP
Attack Card: Gain +1 ATK this turn
Attack Card: Gain +1 DEF this turn
Afterward, discard the 3 selected cards and draw the same number of new cards.
character.astral_craft.jill.skill.passiv:
When using Mix Drink:
If you choose 3 cards of different types, Jill gains 3 Star Coins.
If you choose 3 cards of the same type, the selected target gains +3 Movement Speed this turn.

When using Mix Drink:
If you choose 3 cards of different types, Jill gains 3 Star Coins.
If you choose 3 cards of the same type, the selected target gains +3 Movement Speed this turn.
character.astral_craft.k_angel.profile.b:
Name: OMGkawaii Angel
Birthday: 07/07
Favorite Food: Unknown
An "Internet Angel".
Ame's alter ego while streaming.
Pretends to be
really nice and sweet.
Constantly flirts with nerd types.
character.astral_craft.k_angel.skill.act: Gain 1 Coin. Plus 1 for each 【Fan】 status monster (up to 7 coins). If 【Fan】 status ≥ 3, also heal 3 HP.
Gain 2 Coin. Plus 1 for each 【Fan】 status character or monster (up to 7 coins). If 【Fan】 status ≥ 3, also heal 3 HP.
character.astral_craft.k_angel.skill.pas: Characters and monsters attacking KAngel or being attacked by it applies 【Fan】 status. 【Fan】 status holders lose 1 ATK when against KAngel.
Characters and monsters attacking KAngel or being attacked by it applies 【Fan】 status. 【Fan】 status holders lose 1 ATK when against KAngel. Defeating KAngel clears all [Fan] statuses.
character.astral_craft.komachi.profile.b:
Name: Aoyama Komachi
Birthday: January 8
Favorite Food: Rice
Researcher at Honnsou-in, she specializes in researching ancient Asterism documents. She's also a Tantra ninja, and wears a legendary talking scarf artifact called Strangle.
Ever since Honnsou-in was destroyed during Exorcism Night incident, she's been heavily protected by the Government, so it's hard to meet her.
character.astral_craft.komachi.skill.act: Can play 1 more effect card this turn.
character.astral_craft.komachi.skill.pas: For every 3 Effect Cards played, duplicate the last card and add it to your hand.
character.astral_craft.ling_ling.profile:
Name: Jiao LingLing
Birthday: March 11
Favorite Food: Mashed Potatoes
A former college classmate and close friend of HaiQing and Luga Pixie, LingLing is a slightly unhinged girl with incredible strength. She can lift just about anything she can get her hands on and use it as a weapon. She says she once suffered an illness so grave she might have been possessed by something. Besides her immense strength and control over electricity however, the mysterious sickness has seemingly left no lasting side effects, so she hardly pays it any mind. She's also the former president of the Robot Cosplay Enthusiasts Club.
After graduating, she remained at the university for work, and often goes out with Luga and HaiQing.
character.astral_craft.ling_ling.skill.a:
Choose a number from 1-7 as the final distance for your next Tackle, then immediately perform a Tackle that replaces your next movement.
During the Tackle, group all monsters you pass. After stopping, you may challenge them in sequence. If you pass Enhanced Barricade during the Tackle, grouped monsters gain -2 DEF, and you gain +3 ATK for 2 turns.

Choose a number from 1-5 as the final distance for your next Tackle, then immediately perform a Tackle that replaces your next movement. During the Tackle, group all units you pass, reducing their Defense by 3 for 1 turn. After stopping, you may challenge them in sequence.
character.astral_craft.ling_ling.skill.p: Your Barricade transforms into Enhanced Barricade. At the start of the game, gain an additional 2 Enhanced Barricade. After passing Barricade, gain 1 Enhanced Barricade.
Gain an additional 1 Barricade from Round rewards. After passing Barricade, Skill CD -2, and gain +2 Move for your next movement.
character.astral_craft.luka.profile.basi:
Name: Star Luka
Birthday: February 15
Favourite Food: Salmon
She's the bartender at the "Rainbow Prism" bar, and Kurara's close friend and partner
Eyewitness to the "Exorcism Night" and "Tennnou Drop" incidents.
The spiritual leader of the Midnight Racers, nicknamed "Midnight Flash".
The "Tennou Drop" incident sparked fierce battles between companies, and the "Rainbow Prism" bar, previously serving as a jack-of-all-trades shop, could not avoid involvement. Since the nominal boss of the bar disappeared during the "Exorcism Night", Star Luka has also gradually faded from public view.
Luka occasionally assists Kurara with the bar on Saturdays.
character.astral_craft.luka.skill.active: Movement will use 2 6-sided dice. Moving will deal 2+ATK damage to monsters passed. Can not engage in battle after using this skill.

Movement will use 2 6-sided dice. Moving will deal damage to characters/monsters passed. The damage equal to "half the number of panels between you and the character/monster". Can not engage in battle after using this skill.
character.astral_craft.luka.skill.passiv: Each time passing by or stopping at Check Point, the active skill cooldown is reduced by 2. Can only be triggered once per turn.
Each time passing by or stopping at Check Point, the active skill cooldown is reduced by 2. Can only be triggered once per turn.
character.astral_craft.lulu.profile.basi:
Name: Lulu
Birthday: December 12
Favorite Food: Anything smaller than her
Technical advisor for Ramsey Biotechnology. She is a product of the lab and is highly intelligent. She usually stays in the lab, but occasionally sneaks outside to go on her "hunts", but nobody knows what exactly she is "hunting".
Looks can be deceiving, so don't be fooled by her appearance!
character.astral_craft.lulu.skill.active:
Mark an ally within 10 panels.
The target gains 3 stacks of Heal.
Select 1 player within 10 panels, and make his movement -3. Lasts for 2 turns (no stack).
character.astral_craft.lulu.skill.passiv: After taking damage, gain 1 stack of Heal and reduce the active skill cooldown by 1.
After taking damage, reduce the active skill cooldown by 1.
character.astral_craft.mamushi.profile.b:
Name: Amakawa Mamushi
Birthday: August 21
Favorite Food: Pudding
The Amakawa branch of the Ryugasaki family has always been one of the core families within Mikami. As the daughter of the family head, Mamushi has always been exceptionally diligent compared to her peers.
Yet, no matter how strict the environment, it cannot suppress her natural curiosity - Mamushi is a girl full of wonder.
She is now the official head of the Amakawa family, overseeing all internal and external affairs.
character.astral_craft.mamushi.skill.act:
Mamushi draws one Bite, and all allies up to 5 panels away draw a card.
If an ally has less than 4 cards, they draw an additional card.

Discard a random card from each player's hand that are within 4 panels.
If the player has less than 4 cards, deal 2 damage to them.
character.astral_craft.mamushi.skill.pas:
When other players draw cards, Mamushi gains 1 stack of "Awakening".
When you have 8 stacks of Awakening, Mamushi transforms into her "True Form".
While in True Form, gain +4 ATK and your active skill does not have a range restriction.
Converts all Bite cards in hand and after activation into Dragon Roar.
When damaged, gain +1 ATK and take 1 less damage this turn.
character.astral_craft.megas.profile.bas:
Name: Megas Williams
Birthday: January 23
Favorite Food: Filet Mignon
Bartender at the "Dispersion Prisms" bar and a close friend of Kurara. She witnessed the "Exorcism Night" and "Tennou Drop" incidents. A master of fighting games, she is known as "The Mechanic" for her mastery in controls and mechanical expertise. She has known Ren since childhood, serving as both a rival and a mentor. The "Tennou Drop" incident sparked fierce battles between companies, and Megas experienced significant emotional trauma from it.
She lives with Star Luka and occasionally makes appearances at the bar.
character.astral_craft.megas.skill.activ:
Discard your hand.
For every 2 cards discarded, deal 3 damage to a random Monster up to 6 panels away.
For every Combat Card discarded, total the cost. For each 3 points of this total (rounded up), "Orbital Bombardment" deals 1 extra damage per hit.

Discard all cards.
For every 2 cards discarded, deal 2 damage to a random other character.
character.astral_craft.megas.skill.passi: Draw 1 card at the end of the turn if there are fewer than 6 cards in hand.
Draw 1 card at the end of the turn if there are fewer than 6 cards in hand.
character.astral_craft.mimi.profile.basi:
Name: Mimi
Birthday: August 2
Favorite Food: Lovely bento
Astral Party's poster girl and a hardworker at heart! She can be found working in many workplaces, from grocery stores to supermarkets. Mimi is likely to be seen in various workplaces.
character.astral_craft.mimi.skill.active: Discard all cards, and then draw the same amount of cards with 1 extra draw.
character.astral_craft.mimi.skill.passiv: For each Battle Card discarded, gain 1 coin.
character.astral_craft.misaki.profile.ba:
Name: Ryugasaki Misaki
Birthday: July 20
Favorite food: Matcha ice cream
The guardian of the leader of the Three Gods Religion. The Three Gods is another religious institution as famous as the Asterism Monastery, which dedicates itself to charity work, but also has the same documentary research capabilities as the Ancient Archive Institute. The Ryugasaki family, to which Misaki belongs, is one of the three major families of the Three Gods Religion, along with the Tennoji family and the Yonezawa family.
She is childhood friends with Masao and the leader of the Three Gods, and is a good friend of Aoyama Komachi. She has been investigating the truth behind the "Tennou Drop" incident.
character.astral_craft.misaki.skill.acti: Target a monster within 4 panels, deal 2 damage, and receive 1 Sword Gust (up to a maximum of 3 stacks).
Deal 2 damages to a player within 4 panels, and get 1 Sword Gust. Get 3 Sword Gusts at most.
character.astral_craft.misaki.skill.pass: Get 1 Sword Gust for each on-hit or evasion, 3 at most. ATK +1 for the 1st and 2nd Sword Gust, ATK +3 for the 3rd. Lose all Sword Gusts if get KO.
Get 1 Sword Gust for each on-hit or evasion, 3 at most. ATK +1 for the 1st and 2nd Sword Gust, ATK +3 for the 3rd. Lose all Sword Gusts if get KO.
character.astral_craft.moses.profile.bas:
Name: Seid Moses
Birthday: August 20
Favorite Food: Vegetables safe to eat raw
【Taishin Art Museum】 Part-time Art Restorer.
Though only a part-time position, he actually spends more time here than waiting tables at the 【Dispersion Prisms】, earning him the nickname “the phantom part-timer of the bar” from Kurara. In truth, he’s an expert at handling “anomalous incidents” and one of the elite combatants of the 【Dispersion Prisms】.
He continues to move between the bar and the museum, occasionally gathering intel on missing persons.
character.astral_craft.moses.skill.activ:
Choose a monster, and apply 【Critical Flaw】 to it.
When Moses battles with a monster with 【Critical Flaw】, its dice roll will be fixed at 0.

Choose a player to apply 【Critical Flaw】 to.
During their next battle, the player with 【Critical Flaw】will only roll between 1-3 on attack and defense.
character.astral_craft.moses.skill.passi:
Successfully dodging or conterattack grants Moses 1 stack of 【Weakness Exposed】, up to 3 stacks.
At the end of your turn, lose 1 stack.
Each stack of 【Weakness Exposed】 grants Moses +2 ATK and increases his minimum Dodge roll by 1.
After successfully dodging, gain +4 ATK in your next battle.
Name: Nancy Lu
Birthday: Unknown
Favorite Food: Unknown
A close friend of Kurara, and the waitress at the "Dispersion Prisms" bar, Nancy is a witness to the "Exorcism Night" and "Tennou Drop" incidents. Known in the online world as the "Cyber Phantom" for her legendary hacking skills —a title bestowed by internet kids— she has never revealed her true identity. After the tragic loss of a friend linked to the dark web, she has been quietly investigating the whereabouts of the "Star Engine" in hopes of reviving them.
Rumored to reside permanently at the "Dispersion Prisms".
character.astral_craft.nancy_lu.skill.ac:
Initiate a battle with a monster, this battle will not trigger the discard effect.
If the monster is beyond 3 panels, it will not counterattack in this battle.
Initiate a battle with a character outside of 6 panels, this battle will not trigger the discard effect.
character.astral_craft.nancy_lu.skill.pa: At the start of the turn, if there are no other monsters within a 3 panels, draw a Battle Card, and gain +2 ATK and +2 DEF. When you initiate a battle with an enemy, randomly discard a Battle Cards from your hand after the battle.

At the start of the turn, if there are no other players within a 3 panels, draw a Battle Card, and gain +1 ATK and +1 DEF. When you initiate a battle with an enemy, discard all Battle Cards from your hand after the battle.
character.astral_craft.nardis.profile.ba:
Name: Nardis Enfield
Birthday: September 19
Favorite Food: Grilled Chickpea
Nardis is from a powerful house of Oasis City, also a leading family of Union City. With a strong energy industry, Oasis City holds the lifeblood of Union City's industrial machines. House of Enfield is not only powerful in Oasis City, but also a member of Union City's council.
Nardis lives in Union City, and once in a while visits Oasis City upon the family's call.
character.astral_craft.nardis.skill.acti:
Gain 3 temporary cards in hand.
Temporary cards will be discarded at the end of the turn.
character.astral_craft.nardis.skill.pass:
When engage in battle during your turn, gain +1 attack for each card in hand exceeding the target's,
Maximum +3.
character.astral_craft.padman.profile.ba:
Name: Padman
Birthday: May 20
Favorite Food: Unknown
He's a supernatural creature that doesn't harm people directly, but eats away at the minds of people close by, leading to anxiety, insanity and self-harm. It shows emotions and talks through the tablet, but it's unknown if he's really speaking, or just imitating someone's voice.
The government provided him protection since the Tennou Drop incident.
character.astral_craft.padman.skill.acti: Trigger maximum buff for passive skill for 1 turn.
character.astral_craft.padman.skill.pass: Improve or lower your attributes every turn: ATK -2~+2, DEF -2~+2, Roll -2~+2.
Name: Pandaman
Birthday: October 1
Favorite Food: Leafy greens
Born and raised in Union City. He loves street dance, rock, and otaku culture, and usually performs street dance and does volunteer work in the community. He also occasionally works part-time at Fen's restaurant to fund his expensive hobbies.
If you go to the Three Gods Square in Phoenix District on a weekend afternoon, you can see Pandaman performing.
character.astral_craft.pandaman.skill.ac: Gain one Self-Explosion or Eye for an Eye.
character.astral_craft.pandaman.skill.pa: Healing characters within 5 panels 2 HP after using 'Hamburger' or 'Chocolate Cake'.
character.astral_craft.papara.profile.ba:
Name: Papara
Birthday: October 31
Favorite Food: Anything with ketchup
Guitarist and lead singer of the band "Scarlet Walker", and leader of the underground biker gang in Union City. Music is what she enjoys, but racing is what she lives for. She painted her motorbike a deep red, and plastered it all over with cute stickers.
She's still active in underground racing tracks, and can be found performing at certain venues.
character.astral_craft.papara.skill.acti:
When using skill, if current HP>50%, then HP -3.
Heal HP equal to the 50% damage you dealt.
character.astral_craft.parunan.profile.b:
Name: Parunan Crecia
Birthday: June 14
Favorite Food: As long as it's expensive
A business legend in Union City, and the owner of the Imperial Group.
The Crecia family is a long-established traditional family consortium, and Parunan made the empire even more prosperous, making the Crecia family present throughout all industries in Union City. She's rarely seen in public, only known from photographs of interviews left in newspapers from many years ago.
character.astral_craft.parunan.skill.act: Opens a card shop anywhere, regardless of panels.
character.astral_craft.parunan.skill.pas: Can buy 1 more battle card from shop. Gain 1 coin each time a Shop is entered.
character.astral_craft.ren.profile.basic:
Name: Ren
Birthday: April 23
Favorite Food: Hamburgers
Developer of the hit game "Astral Party", and a pro gamer. The gaming magazine Pamagames claimed she was the best gamer of all time in Union City!
She enjoys collecting vintage electronics, and keeps a grey rat as a pet.
Though she claims to be a "Forever 18 mysterious beauty", she's portrayed in-game as in her teens.
Select a character to draw a card and gain a Shiyu-Shiyu Shield. Shiyu-Shiyu Shield reduces the next damage taken by the target by -99.
Steal a random card from a player within 8 panels; if it is an effect card, refresh the Shiyu-Shiyu shield.
character.astral_craft.ren.skill.passive: When using an active skill on an ally, if the target's HP ≤ their 50% Maximum HP, you also gain a Shiyu-Shiyu Shield and draw a card.
Shiyu-Shiyu is protecting you. Damage taken -3 for the next time.
character.astral_craft.rin.profile.basic:
Name: Crecia Yonezawa Rin
Birthday: May 25
Favorite Food: Chocolate Cookies
The eldest daughter of the Yonezawa family. Although she was expected to be one of the Guardians of the Three Gods, she couldn't tolerate the rigid formalities and arranged a "runaway" with the help of her brother. She currently works as a junior investigator at the Union City Abnormal Investigation Division (UAID). However, her clumsiness often leads to reprimands from her superiors.
To cope with the frustrations and burdens from work, she spends a lot of weekends with Masao, impressing both Masao and Misaki with her exceptional cooking skills.
Gain 1 Living Book; All Effect Card Range +3, lasts 1 turn.
Gain 1 Living Book; All Effect Card Range +3, lasts 1 turn.
character.astral_craft.rin.skill.passive: When the event is triggered, gain 1 Living Book. After each use of Living Book, the damage of Living Book permanently increases by 1.
When the event is triggered, gain 1 Living Book.
character.astral_craft.teru.profile.basi:
Name: Teru
Birthday: February 19
Favorite Food: Grilled Eel
Teru is the current Hierarch of the Three Gods Religion, one of the most influential organizations in Union City, boasting a complex membership structure. While the "Hierarch" rarely shows her face, the ordinary person known as Teru loves going out and having fun.
She doesn't insist on wearing traditional attire to emphasize her position as the Hierarch; on the contrary, she prefers to wear clothing that flatters her figure.
Teru occasionally sneaks off to visit Masao, which causes no small amount of stress for Misaki and the elders within the organization.
